messages:
auditor: Hi team — for the SOC2 evidence bundle we need a few clarifications related to the 2026-02-14 incident window (16:00–17:30 UTC) for org-42. Observations: increased 401/403 auth errors and a concurrent billing spike. Requests: 1) exact log slices (access + auth) for that window; 2) how logs were sampled/retention proof; 3) reproducible steps to trigger the retry-related billing duplication we saw; 4) chain-of-custody / manifest for any exported evidence. Please confirm ETA (auditor needs by EOD PST).

anna-sec: Thanks — we can produce a scoped export and manifest. We'll run a targeted query against access_logs and auth_events, include a sha256 manifest, and the S3 presigned URLs. ETA: export job by EOD PT (we'll ping when done).

cale-sre: Quick note on root cause we found while triaging: a subset of clients aggressively retry on 401 and our meter counts a token issuance event as billable separate from the original request, which can double-count in the spike. I'll attach a short repro below.

maria-support: Linking internal ticket for the customer: https://redwood.support/ticket/3456 — customer reported token rotation failing mid-request then retrying. Support captured a replay trace (redacted) and we scoped customer_id -> org-42.

deploy-bot: [export-job-8721] started export for org_id=org-42 range=2026-02-14T16:00:00Z..2026-02-14T17:30:00Z — artifacts will be available at s3://redwood-evidence/exports/8721/ (manifest will follow) :truck:

anna-sec: Query we'll run for audit (we'll attach raw JSON lines in export):

```
-- auth events
SELECT * FROM auth_events
WHERE org_id = 'org-42'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-02-14T16:00:00Z'
  AND timestamp <= '2026-02-14T17:30:00Z';

-- access logs with billing units
SELECT * FROM access_logs
WHERE org_id = 'org-42'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-02-14T16:00:00Z'
  AND timestamp <= '2026-02-14T17:30:00Z'
  AND status IN (401,403,429);
```

anna-sec: Retention / sampling notes: access_logs are stored in hotstore for 90 days and archived to coldstore (S3) for 365 days. Audit exports include the full coldstore slice; we will provide a signed manifest (sha256 of each object) and an export provenance file (who initiated, job id, bucket path, generation time). We will include a line in the manifest stating: "retention_policy: hot=90d,cold=365d" and a signed timestamped note from compliance.

cale-sre: Minimal repro to demonstrate retry-induced double billing (run against staging endpoints):

```
# simple bash loop that simulates expired token + client retry logic
for i in {1..3}; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer expired-token" \
    -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate || true
  # client obtains new token and retries
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer rotated-token" \
    -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate || true
  sleep 0.5
done
```

cale-sre: When the first request fails with 401, our billing pipeline already attributed the request units; when the client retries after token rotation, that retry is also billed. In production we rely on idempotency keys for write operations but generation calls are not idempotent by default, so retries can inflate counts.

josh-privacy: For the export we will redact full prompt/response payloads per customer privacy config; we will instead provide truncated hashes of content and include the decryption keys/access logs only if the auditor signs the NDA addendum. Please confirm whether the auditor requires full plaintext artifacts or hashed artifacts are sufficient for SOC2 scope.

auditor: We need full plaintext payloads for the sample slices to validate the end-to-end repro and the billing delta (auditor will use redacted copies in the final report). We have an executed NDA addendum on file (see contract 2026-01). Please include manifest and COC (chain-of-custody) docs.

anna-sec: Understood — prepping export with full payloads for the sample window. We'll gate delivery to the presigned s3 path + encrypted bundle and provide access instructions. Expected upload by 18:00 PT; will DM secure link to the auditor and add manifest with sha256 and a signed COC PDF.

maria-support: FYI support reproduced a smaller repro in our sandbox that matches the customer's trace — attaching the support trace id: trace-20260214-16-org42. We'll include that trace in the export as a separate evidence artifact.

cale-sre: After export is complete I'll add a short playbook entry for ops: how to detect retry storms (metric: auth_retry_rate > 0.05 and billing_delta > baseline*2) and mitigation steps (temporary rate-limit by org + noop idempotency token enforcement).

auditor: Thanks — please ping in-thread when links are ready. Auditor will verify manifest checksums and request any additional timestamps if needed.

anna-sec: Will update in this thread when export job finishes and post the presigned link + manifest. :white_check_mark:
summary: Auditor requested log slices, retention proof, repro steps and chain-of-custody for 2026-02-14 auth/billing spike; eng-security/eng-sre/support coordinating exports, manifest, and repro artifacts.
